name: Saltmarch
descriptionSeed: A stilt-town over the shallows of the western sea: salt-pans, net-lofts, and boats for streets. The Saltmarch fishes, salts and sells to anyone, and asks nothing about where you are going.
encounterFlavor: saltfolk, net-menders, and buyers from the Pattern Reach who want salt and no questions
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: pinned at the LANDING where a traveller reaches them, which is also the region's seat on land. The stilt-town stands on the salt flats at the marsh edge.
appearance: Houses on stilts over grey shallows, white salt-pans in square rows, nets drying on every rail, and boats tied up where streets would be.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
